confidence_notes: I ran 5 web searches for food and drink prices and 1 for the RBA rate. The sources were aggregated cost-of-living sites (Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, TravelTables, LivingCost). They are crowd-sourced, thin and often undated, and they disagree. For example, a basic meal ranged from about $2.80 to about $10, and a mid-range dinner for two from about $13 to about $36. I weighted the newer and Expatistan figures and nudged them up slightly because Foz is a tourist hub. Beer, coffee, cocktail and inexpensive meal were reasonably supported. I found no per-glass wine price, only a bottle of table wine at about R$34, so wine_glass is an estimate from the local wine and beer price relationship. Cocktail is based on Expatistan-style figures of about R$20 to R$21, adjusted up for restaurant and tourist pricing. BRL/USD was not looked up, so BRL-to-USD conversions are approximate. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Foz do Iguaçu's tourism-driven lodging market. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any booking pages or listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Foz do Iguaçu's own aggregated price indexes, which place it below Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo and close to other mid-sized southern Brazilian cities such as Cascavel. Accommodation is benchmarked loosely against other Brazilian tourist gateway cities with strong domestic and international demand.
